title: SEBI Grade A IT · 180-Day Roadmap
note: Four focused hours per day. Every seventh plan day is a review day, regardless of calendar weekday. Supplement it with full-length papers. Changing your daily-hours goal changes the tracker target, not these lesson durations. No upcoming exam date is assumed.
